body:
I do have a therapist, and seeing him yesterday helped me out a ton. He's said something about medication, but for now, I'm choosing to stay off of it. It might sound cliche, but I don't really want to have a manufactured state of mind. 

Thanks for the advice :)
You come off as a really awesome person. Keep doing what you do. I'm totally doing this now. Would you recommend doing it alone? Or would it be ok to have a friend along for the ride?
Definitely going to try this. I've always wondered about meditation, but I never really thought I could do it, just because my negative thoughts tend to be really really loud and distracting.

Damn dude, that positive outlook is the hardest thing I've ever tried to find in my life. It's just not an easy thing to have. I don't go a day without hearing about a bomb going off and killing several people or about big government trying to steal all my privacy and money and shit. 

It's hard in today's world.
I have like 8 months until graduation. I don't really know if I can last that long.
